policy.adapted: Semantics or an interface are independently implemented inside greenfield and protected by greenfield tests/evidence.
policy.direct_reuse: A non-model utility in glm-tpu is called directly and remains outside the greenfield model execution graph.
policy.oracle_only: The source may produce or explain reference evidence but must never be imported by greenfield model execution.
policy.rejected: Preserved negative evidence; do not repeat or promote the mechanism without a new discriminator.
policy.research_candidate: Pinned source for a future default-off isolated challenger; no performance or correctness claim yet.

One default-off callback reuses the proven DSA dump boundary to capture only one selected full-indexer producer's position-8155 normalized hidden, q-a state, query, head weights and current pre-cache key. Its second oracle-only commit uses the scorer's existing zero-copy torchax-to-JAX bridge, regression-tested under an outer JIT. The protected wrappers require exact raw tokens, bitwise-identical sealed DSA event tensors, DB/archive linkage and clean census. Legacy execution never enters greenfield execution.

assets.reason: The protected accepted capture localizes its independent reconstruction divergence to query while normalized hidden and q-a state are bitwise exact. DB499 proves that raw FP8 bits/scales produce the exact accepted query only when both the accepted q-a input and the complete topology-local FP32 wq_b owner shard are present before the true M=1 projection. The later production observer proves production q-a is already nonexact, so DB499 must never be cited as proof of the full production query producer. assets.source_repo: tpu-inference, vLLM reference, and accepted glm-run XPlane
assets.reason: The source and accepted XPlane jointly prove a 32-way FP32 variance all-reduce followed by a BF16 rank-3 all-gather at q_a_layernorm. DB490 rejects scorer geometry; the pinned config and accepted vLLM source prove q_a/kv_a RMSNorm epsilon 1e-5; DB491 shows that correction cuts mean score error about 17x but still misses 1,408 order slots. A source-faithful logical-width GSPMD mean is bitwise identical to the manual distributed norm on forced-32 exact BF16 inputs and retains the same full-geometry collective association, so no redundant TPU run is warranted. Greenfield independently reproduces only this bounded oracle association; it remains forbidden in production layers.

The accepted layer-0 fused wk_weights_proj leaf is BF16 and repaired from raw FP8 into that dtype before the DSA adapter casts it to FP32. Protected launch 20260807T235427 proves that BF16-origin and direct-FP32-origin wk produce elementwise-identical prompt keys after projection, key LayerNorm, RoPE and BF16 cache storage. It stopped before scoring by design, has no DB/SUCCESS/performance claim, and ended with authenticated 8/8 cleanup. Preserve the accepted BF16-origin production-state identity, but never rerun it as a DSA-order discriminator.

assets.source_repo: tpu-inference, vLLM reference, and protected glm-run evidence
assets.reason: GLM adds no embedding multiplier: layer 0 consumes the raw BF16 selected row, clones it as residual, and applies model-epsilon RMSNorm. Vocab sharding masks nonowners and all-reduces one nonzero BF16 row; the TPU OOT layer delegates unchanged. Greenfield already selects those exact raw rows. Accepted layer-0 byte sums pin embedding 1668496656, input norm 1006936, adapted weights_proj 48158645, adapted wk 193298069, adapted wq_b 3765880530, fused wk_weights_proj 241456714 and q-a norm 305844. The input/embedding path is source-exhausted as an unexplained DSA discriminator.

DB485 pins the XLA scorer, DCP8, max_model_len 8704, owned three-block walk, local P=512 stripe, and 24 cache blocks. Greenfield independently reproduces that bounded R=32 local body and stitches shards outside the compiled scorer; production remains one row.
